notes.status: UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. The Solana vault needs its own external audit before any real funds
notes.tool: tools/signatario-solana/sol_vault.py (validate / address / init / verify); the owner deploys the program and initializes the vault, never an agent
notes.address: the vault address is derived from the hash of every value under vault (and the chain id derived from solana.genesisHash): changing any value gives another vault at another address. Nothing here can be changed after initialize; the program has no owner and no setter
notes.mint: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v is Circle's USDC mint on Solana (Circle's address table and getAccountInfo at finalized, 2026-11-16): classic SPL Token program, 6 decimals, mint authority BJE5MMbqXjVwjAF7oxwPYXnTXDyspzZyt4vwenNw5ruG, freeze authority 7dGbd2QZcCKcTndnHcTL8q7SMVXAkp688NTQYwrRCrar
notes.sourceChainId: not in this file: the tool derives it from solana.genesisHash as keccak256("BLOCH-SVM-CHAIN-ID-v1" || the 32 genesis hash bytes). For mainnet-beta: 0x720ef12f64972f1d7a826f17e9d177f041fbca3173c9bce00aa50eac2c22fdec
notes.labels: sourceDomainLabel, nativeDomainLabel and assetLabel become bytes32 by right-padding the ASCII text with zeros, as Solidity bytes32("...")
notes.cap: proposed 100,000 USDC, equal to the L2 token's supplyCap (busdc-sol-token.config.json)
notes.windowLimit: proposed 10,000 USDC per 24 h: the release token bucket and the largest single deposit; equal to the L2 bucketCapacity, the largest single burn
notes.signers: the seven eth-release-signer keys of docs/BRIDGE-V3-KEY-CEREMONY.md, as 0x Ethereum-style addresses, ascending; threshold 5. The same keys as the Ethereum vault: every digest contains this vault's chain id and vault id, so a certificate of one vault is not valid on the other. A release approval of 7 signatures does not fit a Solana transaction; 5 and 6 do
notes.unpauseThreshold: 6 of 7 to end a guardian pause early (switchThreshold on Ethereum; this vault has no light-client switch)
notes.guard: the three eth-vault-guardian secp256k1 keys, as 0x addresses, ascending, none of them a signer. A guardian signs a pause authorization; anyone delivers it. 72 h pause, 72 h cooldown. A pause voids approvals not yet paid
notes.largeRelease: Solana only: a release above largeReleaseThreshold (proposed 1,000 USDC) waits releaseDelay (proposed 1,800 s) between approval and payment. The Ethereum launch vault has releaseDelay 0: this is a difference for the coordinator to confirm or set to 0 / 0
notes.maxValidSeconds: a certificate's validUntil may be at most this far ahead (proposed 3,600 s)
notes.minDeposit: proposed 11 USDC: with the 5 bps deposit fee it nets 10.9945 USDC, above l2MinBurn 10
notes.fees: 5 bps of each deposit and 5 bps of each release, ceiling 30 bps in the program. Fees accrue outside the backing; anyone calls sweep_fees and the vault pays the associated token account of fees.owner. owner: BMnorAB28mGPthJkbC2iLxbEpWYRCHafgNzV3o8eAJL8, the owner's address on Solana (round 16 brief, 2026-11-16); it is a point on the ed25519 curve (a wallet address) and had no account on chain on 2026-11-16. Its USDC associated token account is 2VMpYFjydEYUu1Jw8KhfxBGDT7zRUkBqjKc6DZziqayg (seeds: owner, token program, mint; bump 253), which must be created before the first sweep. Immutable once the vault is initialized
